function.name: q_ask
function.description: Ask the team's internal APIs (metrics, deploy status, on-call, feature flags, health/NIS scores) in plain English. q routes the question to the right internal endpoint and injects auth; you do not need endpoint URLs or schemas. Use for live, private, or account-specific data — not general knowledge.

question.description: The question to answer, in plain English (e.g. 'deploy status for checkout-service').
